name: deepseek-cli
description: Minimal CLI for calling DeepSeek's language models (pro/flash) via direct HTTP with SSE streaming

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir ../../dist --target bun --minify --sourcemap=external && cd ../../dist && mv index.js deepseek-cli.js && mv index.js.map deepseek-cli.js.map
